items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Watts had me and a guitar and a drum and himself

ctx.x:

So that lasted for a while. Then I decided that I wanted to go... I went down to a little place called Wewoka. That's right down the road about nineteen miles from Seminole. So I went down there, and I ran into a guy named J.R. Watts, who was a piano player.
